signals.title: Puppet Show: Winnie the Pooh (Мечо Пух)
signals.location: State Puppet Theatre Plovdiv, 14 Hristo G. Danov St, Plovdiv
signals.reason: A gentle, universally familiar story told through charming puppetry that is perfectly paced and captivating for a 4-year-old.

signals.title: Puppet Play: Tale of the Blue Globe (Приказка за синьото кълбо)
signals.location: State Puppet Theatre, 46 General Gurko St, Stara Zagora
signals.reason: An imaginative, colourful, visual production that is easy for a preschooler to follow, paired with an easy ~70-minute drive.

signals.title: Live Falconry and Birds of Prey Evening
signals.reason: Held at the family's favourite museum, featuring a live demonstration of falcons and raptors with an experienced falconer.
signals.note: Confirmed on factor-news.net and Regional Natural History Museum Plovdiv announcement.

signals.title: Children's Musical: Beard Glue (Лепило за брада)
signals.location: Boris Hristov House of Culture, Plovdiv
signals.reason: A playful and vibrant children's musical staged by Opera Plovdiv filled with upbeat songs and comedic characters.

signals.title: Kapana Christmas Craft Market
signals.reason: Festive pedestrian stroll with glowing lights, wooden stalls, warm treats, and an antique holiday photo sleigh.

signals.title: Puppet Show: Pin and Polly's Christmas (Коледата на Пин и Поли)
signals.location: State Puppet Theatre Plovdiv, 14 Hristo G. Danov St, Plovdiv
signals.reason: A cozy holiday puppet production designed specifically for younger audiences aged 3 and above.

signals.title: Aviation Museum Krumovo
signals.location: Aviation Museum, Plovdiv Airport perimeter, Krumovo
signals.reason: Just a 15-minute drive from Plovdiv, this open-air museum lets a toddler safely roam among real planes and helicopters.

signals.title: Major road closures around Hristo Botev Stadium for Botev Plovdiv vs. CSKA Sofia match
signals.location: Blvd. Iztochen, ul. Bogomil, ul. Varshava, and ul. Lev Tolstoy, Plovdiv
signals.reason: High-risk matchday crowd controls completely shut primary east-central traffic arteries and divert municipal bus lines.

signals.title: Morning traffic signal shutdowns and manual police traffic regulation on Komatevsko Shose
signals.location: Komatevsko Shose intersections with Blvd. Aleksandar Stamboliyski and Blvd. Nikola Vaptsarov, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Traffic lights will be powered off with police officers manually directing peak commuter traffic on major south Plovdiv corridors.

signals.title: Permanent vehicle closure and pedestrianisation works of ulitsa Ivan Vazov
signals.location: Ulitsa Ivan Vazov (section from Central Square to ulitsa Avksentiy Veleshki), Plovdiv
signals.reason: Major permanent pedestrian zone extension transforming a key central thoroughfare connecting Central Square and the National Library.

signals.title: Plovdiv Airport finalizing 8 new direct scheduled European flight routes
signals.when_text: Route agreements concluding late November 2026; flights launch March 2027
signals.reason: Major expansion of direct international connectivity from Plovdiv to Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Ireland, Turkey, and Poland.

signals.title: Classical Piano Recital: Beethoven Op. 31 Sonatas by Ivan Donchev
signals.location: AMTII Concert Hall, ulitsa Todor Samodumov 2, Old Town, Plovdiv
signals.reason: High-calibre solo classical piano performance of Beethoven's Opus 31 masterpieces in an intimate Old Town hall; entirely non-verbal.

signals.title: Kinomania 2026: Arthouse Screening of Cannes Palme d'Or Winner 'Fiord'
signals.location: LUCKY House of Cinema (LUCKY Дом на киното), ulitsa William Gladstone 1, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Exclusive festival cinema screening of a Cannes festival laureate at Plovdiv's premier independent cinema; subtitled cinema screening.

signals.title: The Chicago Experience (TCE) Live in Concert
signals.location: Kolodrum Sports Hall, Blvd. Asenovgradsko Shose, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Original founding members and touring vocalists of the legendary American horn-rock band Chicago performing their iconic song catalogue live; English lyrics.

signals.title: Contemporary Art Retrospective: 'The Beginning. 130 Years. To the Present Day'
signals.location: '2019' Exhibition Hall, ulitsa William Gladstone 32, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Curated modern visual art retrospective celebrating Bulgarian contemporary artists; strictly visual medium requiring no Bulgarian fluency.

signals.title: Dom na Kinoto (LUCKY House of Cinema)
signals.reason: Plovdiv's sole dedicated arthouse cinema venue, regularly scheduling festival features, original-audio cinema, and European film releases.
